label: HEALING

cover.headline: Leave this year *lighter*
cover.sub: 5 things you can let go of.

points.heading: The what-ifs
points.body: You did your best with what you knew then.
points.panel: “I’m done replaying it. I’m moving forward.”

points.heading: Waiting for an apology
points.body: You can heal even if you never hear “sorry.”
points.panel: “I don’t need his words to move on.”

points.heading: The old timeline
points.body: Life rarely follows the plan, and that’s okay.
points.panel: Write one new hope for the year ahead.

points.heading: Harsh self-talk
points.body: Speak to yourself the way you would to a friend.
points.panel: “I’ve been through a lot, and I’m still standing.”

points.heading: Things that remind you too much
points.panel: Box up a few reminders, and put them out of sight.

close.save: Save this for New Year’s Eve.

caption:
As the year ends, it’s a good moment to decide what you don’t want to carry into the next one.

Letting go doesn’t mean forgetting. It means making room. These five things are worth setting down, gently, so you can step into the new year a little lighter. You’ve earned it.

Save this for New Year’s Eve, and follow @roundabloom for more.
